DROP TABLE quote_edp_results;
CREATE TABLE quote_edp_results ( id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), quote_id INT NOT NULL, edp_id INT NOT NULL, edp_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, edp_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, impact JSONB NOT NULL, levy_excluding_vat NUMERIC(12, 2), levy_base_amount NUMERIC(12, 2), levy_inflation_adjusted NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL, levy_model_version INT NOT NULL, catchments JSONB, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, CONSTRAINT fk_quote_edp_results_quote_id FOREIGN KEY (quote_id) REFERENCES quotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT uq_quote_edp_results_quote_edp UNIQUE (quote_id, edp_id), CONSTRAINT ck_quote_edp_results_catchments CHECK ( catchments IS NULL OR ( jsonb_typeof(catchments) = 'array' AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(catchments, 'strict $[*] ? (@.type() <> "object")') AND NOT jsonb_path_exists(catchments, 'lax $[*] ? ( !exists(@.label) || @.label.type() <> "string" || !exists(@.catchmentId) || (@.catchmentId.type() <> "string" && @.catchmentId.type() <> "null") || !exists(@.catchmentOverlapPercentage) || @.catchmentOverlapPercentage.type() <> "number" || @.catchmentOverlapPercentage < 0 || @.catchmentOverlapPercentage > 100)') ) ) );
